brief.title: 2Z LIVE: The Ultimate K-Pop Concert Experience Promo!
brief.targetAudience: K-Pop fans, particularly those interested in boy groups, live music events, and energetic performances, aged 13-35.
brief.storyline: A fast-paced montage of 2Z's most iconic concert moments, showcasing their powerful vocals, synchronized dance moves, and captivating stage visuals. Interspersed with quick cuts of fan reactions, light sticks, and the overall electric atmosphere of a K-Pop concert. The narrative builds to a climax, teasing the upcoming concert as an unmissable event.
brief.videoStructure: 0-10s: Quick cuts of high-energy performance snippets, close-ups of 2Z members, impactful beats. 10-25s: Focus on intricate choreography and powerful vocal moments, interspersed with crowd shots. 25-40s: Behind-the-scenes glimpses or rehearsal shots (if available) hinting at the hard work, followed by more live performance highlights with special effects. 40-55s: Title card with concert details (date, city, ticket info) with exciting background music and quick flashes of 2Z. 55-60s: Strong call to action to buy tickets.
brief.subtitleStyle: Dynamic, animated K-Pop style subtitles for lyrics or key messages, using bold, vibrant colors that pop against the video, with occasional motion graphics.
brief.voiceoverStyle: Energetic and enthusiastic male voiceover, speaking in English, building excitement and emphasizing key concert details. Should be brief and impactful.
brief.musicSuggestion: A high-tempo, instrumental K-Pop track with strong beats and a catchy melody, preferably an instrumental version of one of 2Z's popular songs, or a custom track that matches their sound. The music should build in intensity throughout the video.
brief.socialMediaTips: Utilize relevant hashtags like #2Z #KPopConcert #LiveMusic #ConcertPromo #KPopIdol. Encourage user-generated content by asking fans to share their favorite 2Z moments or what they're most excited for. Run a TikTok challenge related to a 2Z dance move. Collaborate with K-Pop fan accounts for wider reach.
brief.ctaSuggestion: Text overlay: 'Tickets On Sale Now!' and 'Link in Bio to Get Your Tickets!' accompanied by a clear visual of a 'Buy Tickets' button. Verbal CTA: 'Don't miss 2Z Live! Get your tickets today!'

brief.targetAudience: KPOP爱好者，特别是关注男团或2Z的粉丝；喜欢快节奏、视觉冲击强烈的音乐视频的用户；对新歌发布和音乐潮流感兴趣的TikTok用户。
brief.storyline: 视频以2Z成员在不同场景下的个人特写开场，结合快节奏的剪辑和色彩斑斓的灯光效果，营造神秘而充满活力的氛围。随后，穿插集体舞蹈片段，展现整齐划一的KPOP编舞力量感。在歌曲高潮部分，画面和舞蹈动作达到顶点，配合歌词的精髓展示，最后以新歌发布日期和专辑名称的字幕作结。
brief.videoStructure: 0-10秒：快闪式个人特写镜头，成员面部表情与眼神杀，配合新歌Intro部分。10-30秒：多场景切换的舞蹈片段，展现KPOP核心编舞，节奏感强，画面冲击力大。30-50秒：歌曲高潮部分，成员情绪爆发，结合特写与整体舞蹈，歌词字幕突出。50-60秒：新歌发布信息、专辑封面、2Z Logo，并引导用户关注和预购。
brief.subtitleStyle: KPOP MV常用风格，字体现代、醒目，颜色与视频整体色调保持一致，可在高潮部分采用动态或闪烁效果，主要展示歌词关键句和发布信息。
brief.voiceoverStyle: 无需配音，视频以音乐为主导。若有必要，可在结尾处加入艺人或官方的简短、有力量的Slogan。
brief.musicSuggestion: 使用2Z新歌的Intro、高潮部分和标志性Hook，确保音乐在60秒内能完整呈现新歌的精髓和记忆点。
